patterns.note: Full-bleed video and image sections dominate the page, each filling the viewport and acting as a distinct content block with minimal, centered text overlays.
Impactful, large, bold, and wide-set sans-serif headings are used for primary statements, often paired with smaller, uppercase sans-serif labels or subheadings.
A high-contrast dark mode palette is used, featuring white text against dark backgrounds, with the full-bleed video/image sections introducing natural, muted colors.
Full-screen sections transition vertically on scroll, often with text fading or sliding into view as each section becomes active.
A persistent header with a logo and navigation buttons, along with a left-aligned menu, appears and sticks to the top of the viewport after an initial scroll threshold.
Client logos are presented in a horizontally expanding or staggered reveal grid, where more logos animate into view as the user scrolls down.

technique_notes: Full-bleed video and image sections are used as primary content blocks, each designed to fill the viewport, with a dark, semi-transparent overlay applied to ensure text readability.

Scroll-triggered animations (likely using GSAP ScrollTrigger, as indicated by 'gsap' detection) are employed to transition between these full-screen sections, making them appear to 'snap' into view or replace the previous section. Text elements within these sections fade in or slide up as their parent section becomes active.
A sticky header and a left-aligned navigation menu are revealed after the user scrolls past the initial hero content, remaining fixed at the top of the viewport for persistent access.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, impactful headings (~4-5x body) with generous letter spacing, paired with smaller, often uppercase, descriptive labels.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, especially between full-bleed sections and within the hero, with content often centered and surrounded by ample negative space.

standout: The site's distinctive use of full-bleed, cinematic video and image sections, each acting as a powerful visual statement with minimal, impactful text overlays, creates an immersive and highly polished storytelling experience. The 'anti-marketing' copy style further enhances its unique, confident brand voice.
